title: Bottom-row page map to the spectral-object abutment
statement: Let C be abelian and Y an EInt-indexed first-quadrant spectral object with its standard E2 spectral sequence [def-sp-spectral-sequence]. For p a natural number and r an integer at least 2, set a=2-r and c=r-1. Define m_(p,r):E_r^(p,0) -> H_Y^p(bottom,top) as follows: identify the page term with E_Y^p(a,0,1,c); apply iota-E to opZ_Y^p(0,1,c), then fromOpcycles to H_Y^p(0,c); apply the inverse of H_Y^p(bottom,c)->H_Y^p(0,c), then H_Y^p(bottom,c)->H_Y^p(bottom,top). The inverse exists by first-quadrant vanishing of H_Y^p(bottom,0) and H_Y^(p+1)(bottom,0). These maps define an explicit morphism, with no choice of an existence witness.
